s0001.literal: In the twenty-first year, spring, first month, on yimao day, the Emperor took the throne at Great Brightness Hall; right grand councillor Huluhuosun led all officials in presenting jade registers and jade seals, offering the honorific title Emperor of Observing Heaven and Expounding the Way, Humaneness, Culture, Righteousness, Martial Grandeur, and Great Filial Brightness; princes and officials offered congratulations according to the new-moon morning ceremony; an amnesty was proclaimed throughout the empire.
s0001.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year, on yimao day of the first month of spring, the Emperor took the throne in Great Brightness Hall. Right grand councillor Huluhuosun led all officials in presenting jade registers and seals and offering the honorific title Emperor of Observing Heaven and Expounding the Way, Humaneness, Culture, Righteousness, Martial Grandeur, and Great Filial Brightness. Princes and officials offered congratulations as on a new-moon morning, and an amnesty was proclaimed throughout the empire.

s0002.literal: On dingsi day an edict said: "From now on, whoever memorializes must first tell his colleagues what is to be memorialized.
s0002.idiomatic: On dingsi day an edict said, "From now on, whoever memorializes must first tell his colleagues what is to be memorialized.

s0003.literal: After memorializing, what imperial rescript was received must be made known to colleagues before it is written in the register;
s0003.idiomatic: After memorializing, whatever imperial rescript was received must be made known to colleagues before it is written in the register;

s0004.literal: whoever writes in the register without clearly informing others shall be flogged by the bichur guards."
s0004.idiomatic: whoever writes in the register without clearly informing others shall be flogged by the bichur guards."

s0005.literal: On jiwei day the Yunnan chief marshal command was abolished; its military and civilian population was placed under the branch secretariat.
s0005.idiomatic: On jiwei day the Yunnan chief marshal command was abolished, and its military and civilian population was placed under the branch secretariat.

s0006.literal: On jiazi day the auditing officials of Yangzhou and other places were abolished; the matter was transferred to the branch secretariat.
s0006.idiomatic: On jiazi day the auditing officials of Yangzhou and other places were abolished, and the matter was transferred to the branch secretariat.

s0007.literal: Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat grand councillor Manghudai presented one hundred jin of pearls.
s0007.idiomatic: Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat grand councillor Manghudai presented 100 jin of pearls.

s0008.literal: On bingyin day Kuoniyadun said: "Two thousand troops garrison-farming at Shaobo Pond were sown with two thousand shi of seed; the harvest was more than twenty-five thousand shi of long- and glutinous-grain rice; I ask to add two thousand newly submitted troops."
s0008.idiomatic: On bingyin day Kuoniyadun said, "Two thousand troops garrison-farming at Shaobo Pond were sown with 2,000 shi of seed and harvested more than 25,000 shi of long- and glutinous-grain rice; I ask to add 2,000 newly submitted troops."

s0010.literal: On dingmao day the Prince of Jiandu, Wumeng, and twelve places including Jinchi all submitted.
s0010.idiomatic: On dingmao day the Prince of Jiandu, Wumeng, and twelve places including Jinchi all submitted.

s0011.literal: Jiandu had first been controlled by Burma and wished to submit but could not.
s0011.idiomatic: Jiandu had first been controlled by Burma and wished to submit but could not.

s0012.literal: At this time Prince Xiangwudaer together with branch secretariat right vice censor Da Bu and associate administrator Yehan Dejin campaigned against Burma by separate routes; at the Axi and Ahe rivers they built two hundred boats, attacked downstream, took Jiangtou City, and ordered commander-in-chief Yuan Shi'an to garrison it.
s0012.idiomatic: At this time Prince Xiangwudaer, branch secretariat right vice censor Da Bu, and associate administrator Yehan Dejin campaigned against Burma by separate routes. At the Axi and Ahe rivers they built 200 boats, attacked downstream, took Jiangtou City, and ordered commander-in-chief Yuan Shi'an to garrison it.

s0013.literal: Envoys were then dispatched to summon and instruct the king of Burma; he did not respond.
s0013.idiomatic: Envoys were then sent to summon and instruct the king of Burma; he did not respond.

s0014.literal: Taigong City of Jiandu was their stronghold; government forces then advanced by land and water, attacked Taigong City, took it, and hence at this time all submitted.
s0014.idiomatic: Taigong City of Jiandu was their stronghold. Government forces advanced by land and water, attacked Taigong City, took it, and hence all now submitted.

s0015.literal: On gengwu day traveling privy councils for Jiang-Huai, Jing-Hu, Jiangxi, and Sichuan were established, based at Jiankang, Ezhou, Fuzhou, and Chengdu.
s0015.idiomatic: On gengwu day traveling privy councils for Jiang-Huai, Jing-Hu, Jiangxi, and Sichuan were established at Jiankang, Ezhou, Fuzhou, and Chengdu.

s0016.literal: The Tamna Kingdom pacification commission was established.
s0016.idiomatic: The Tamna Kingdom pacification commission was established.

s0017.literal: On xinwei day Xiangwudaer dispatched envoys to present pearls, coral, exotic silks, and seven-treasure belts offered by Burma.
s0017.idiomatic: On xinwei day Xiangwudaer sent envoys to present pearls, coral, exotic silks, and seven-treasure belts offered by Burma.

s0018.literal: On jiaxu day one Mongol official and one Hanlin Academy official were dispatched to sacrifice at the mountains, rivers, and earth altar.
s0018.idiomatic: On jiaxu day one Mongol official and one Hanlin Academy official were sent to sacrifice at the mountains, rivers, and earth altar.

s0019.literal: Wang Jiweng was dispatched bearing an edict as envoy to Japan and granted brocade robes, jade rings, and saddle gear.
s0019.idiomatic: Wang Jiweng was dispatched bearing an edict as envoy to Japan and granted brocade robes, jade rings, and saddle gear.

s0020.literal: Jiweng sailed from Qingyuan by sea to the vicinity of Japan and was killed by boatmen.
s0020.idiomatic: Jiweng sailed from Qingyuan by sea to the vicinity of Japan and was killed by boatmen.

s0021.literal: Censorate officials said: "Persons dismissed for crime are long forgotten by name yet again memorialized for employment; we ask that this be forbidden and regulated.
s0021.idiomatic: Censorate officials said, "Persons dismissed for crime are long forgotten by name yet again memorialized for employment; we ask that this be forbidden and regulated.

s0022.literal: " The Emperor said: "What you say is indeed right, yet are there not among them some whose offenses were light and who may be employed?
s0022.idiomatic: " The Emperor said, "What you say is indeed right, yet are there not among them some whose offenses were light and who may be employed?

s0023.literal: " Censor-in-chief Yusutemür replied: "Let each person's criminal circumstances be clearly set forth in memorial; whether to employ them should await imperial decision.
s0023.idiomatic: " Censor-in-chief Yusutemür replied, "Let each person's criminal circumstances be clearly set forth in memorial; whether to employ them should await imperial decision.

s0025.literal: On bingzi day the Jianning rebel Huang Hua killed himself.
s0025.idiomatic: On bingzi day the Jianning rebel Huang Hua killed himself.

s0026.literal: On dingchou day surveillance officials of the various Yunnan routes had farewell audience at court; an edict instructed them: "When you arrive there, you must clearly announce my intent: do not seek goods and wealth; when reputation is established goods and wealth follow; if you pursue wealth you will surely lose your reputation, and your lives also cannot be preserved."
s0026.idiomatic: On dingchou day surveillance officials of the various Yunnan routes had farewell audience at court. An edict instructed them, "When you arrive there, clearly announce my intent: do not seek goods and wealth. When reputation is established, goods and wealth follow; if you pursue wealth you will surely lose your reputation, and your lives also cannot be preserved."

s0027.literal: On jimao day the kingdom of Ma-ba dispatched envoys to offer pearls, exotic treasures, and silk cloth as tribute.
s0027.idiomatic: On jimao day the kingdom of Ma-ba dispatched envoys to offer pearls, exotic treasures, and silk cloth as tribute.

s0028.literal: Second month, on xinsi day, Fujian pacification commissioner Guan Rude was made associate administrator of the Quanzhou branch secretariat to campaign against Burma.
s0028.idiomatic: In the second month, on xinsi day, Fujian pacification commissioner Guan Rude was made associate administrator of the Quanzhou branch secretariat to campaign against Burma.

s0030.literal: The building of Japan expedition ships by Goryeo was halted.
s0030.idiomatic: The building of Japan expedition ships by Goryeo was halted.

s0031.literal: On dinghai day Hanlin Academician-in-Chief Sariman was ordered to sacrifice to the First Farmer at the sacred field.
s0031.idiomatic: On dinghai day Hanlin Academician-in-Chief Sariman was ordered to sacrifice to the First Farmer at the sacred field.

s0032.literal: On renchen day the wives and children of Jiangxi rebel bandits were granted to the hawk office keepers of tigers.
s0032.idiomatic: On renchen day the wives and children of Jiangxi rebel bandits were granted to the hawk office keepers of tigers.

s0033.literal: More than seven hundred deserting troops under Biesudai were assigned to the Prince of Anxi for garrison-farming and given oxen and implements.
s0033.idiomatic: More than 700 deserting troops under Biesudai were assigned to the Prince of Anxi for garrison-farming and given oxen and implements.

s0034.literal: Commoners Huang Dacheng and others of Yongzhou and Binzhou rebelled; commoners of Wuzhou, Shaozhou, and Hengzhou rose one after another; Hunan pacification commissioner Sariman led troops to suppress them.
s0034.idiomatic: Commoners Huang Dacheng and others of Yongzhou and Binzhou rebelled, and commoners of Wuzhou, Shaozhou, and Hengzhou rose one after another. Hunan pacification commissioner Sariman led troops to suppress them.

s0035.literal: On jiawu day the herd pasturage offices were abolished.
s0035.idiomatic: On jiawu day the herd pasturage offices were abolished.

s0036.literal: On jihai day Ruizhou captured thirty-two rebel commoners including Yan Shun, together with their wives and children, and sent them to the capital.
s0036.idiomatic: On jihai day Ruizhou captured 32 rebel commoners including Yan Shun, together with their wives and children, and sent them to the capital.

s0037.literal: Abaqchi's river-opening project was halted; his army and ten thousand sailors each were assigned to transport grain by sea route.
s0037.idiomatic: Abaqchi's river-opening project was halted; his army and 10,000 sailors each were assigned to transport grain by sea route.

s0038.literal: Five hundred gold-washers of Tanzhou were released to return home.
s0038.idiomatic: 500 gold-washers of Tanzhou were released to return home.

s0039.literal: On dingwei day Jiangnan musicians were registered and levied.
s0039.idiomatic: On dingwei day Jiangnan musicians were registered and levied.

s0040.literal: Atahai was ordered to dispatch fifteen thousand troops and two hundred ships to assist the campaign against Champa; ships were insufficient and Jiangxi Province was ordered to supply more.
s0040.idiomatic: Atahai was ordered to dispatch 15,000 troops and 200 ships to assist the campaign against Champa; ships were insufficient and Jiangxi Province was ordered to supply more.

s0041.literal: On wushen day the Jiang-Huai Branch Secretariat was moved to Hangzhou; the Zhe-xi pacification commission was moved to Pingjiang; the Huangzhou pacification commission was abolished and merged into the Huai-xi circuit.
s0041.idiomatic: On wushen day the Jiang-Huai branch secretariat was moved to Hangzhou, the Zhe-xi pacification commission to Pingjiang, and the Huangzhou pacification commission was abolished and merged into the Huai-xi circuit.

s0042.literal: A dharma wheel pillar was erected at Longevity Mountain within the palace precinct, one hundred chi high.
s0042.idiomatic: A dharma wheel pillar was erected at Longevity Mountain within the palace precinct, 100 chi high.

s0043.literal: Bandits rose in Zhangzhou; the Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat was ordered to mobilize troops to advance and suppress them.
s0043.idiomatic: Bandits rose in Zhangzhou; the Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat was ordered to mobilize troops to advance and suppress them.

s0044.literal: Qinzhou prefect Liu Fa was guilty; he had wished to join Huang Hua; when the affair was discovered he was executed; former Song imperial clan members and ministers who had entered service were moved to the interior.
s0044.idiomatic: Qinzhou prefect Liu Fa was guilty; he had wished to join Huang Hua. When the affair was discovered he was executed, and former Song imperial clan members and ministers who had entered service were moved to the interior.

s0045.literal: Third month, on xinhai day, an edict directed that officials managing military and civilians in Si and Bo circuits from now on should not be transferred.
s0045.idiomatic: In the third month, on xinhai day, an edict directed that officials managing military and civilians in Si and Bo circuits should not be transferred from now on.

s0046.literal: On dingsi day the imperial son, Prince of Beiping Namuhe, arrived from the northern frontier.
s0046.idiomatic: On dingsi day the imperial son, Prince of Beiping Namuhe, arrived from the northern frontier.

s0047.literal: The prince had in the eighth year of Zhiyuan built a camp at Alimali north of Karakorum, remained seven years, and only now returned; right grand councillor An Tong arrived afterward.
s0047.idiomatic: The prince had in the eighth year of Zhiyuan built a camp at Alimali north of Karakorum, remained seven years, and only now returned; right grand councillor An Tong arrived afterward.

s0048.literal: Zhang Hongfan and others were placed in command of newly submitted troops.
s0048.idiomatic: Zhang Hongfan and others were placed in command of newly submitted troops.

s0049.literal: On renxu day tiger tallies were redesigned.
s0049.idiomatic: On renxu day tiger tallies were redesigned.

s0050.literal: On bingyin day the imperial carriage traveled to Shangdu.
s0050.idiomatic: On bingyin day the imperial carriage traveled to Shangdu.

s0051.literal: On dingmao day the main hall of the Imperial Ancestral Temple was completed and spirit tablets were installed.
s0051.idiomatic: On dingmao day the main hall of the Imperial Ancestral Temple was completed and spirit tablets were installed.

s0052.literal: On jiaxu day garrison troops were placed at Chao, Gan, Ji, Fu, and Jianchang.
s0052.idiomatic: On jiaxu day garrison troops were placed at Chao, Gan, Ji, Fu, and Jianchang.

s0053.literal: On yihai day King Wang Chun of Goryeo, because the ceremony for the Emperor's honorific title was completed, dispatched envoys to offer congratulations.
s0053.idiomatic: On yihai day King Wang Chun of Goryeo, because the ceremony for the Emperor's honorific title was completed, sent envoys to offer congratulations.

s0054.literal: Summer, fourth month, on renwu day, military and civilians were ordered jointly to build dikes and dams to benefit the five guards' garrison fields.
s0054.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, on renwu day, military and civilians were ordered jointly to build dikes and dams to benefit the five guards' garrison fields.

s0055.literal: On yiyou day the Treasury Bureau was abolished and merged into the Ministry of Revenue; the Dadu capital intendant's office concurrently managing the Palace Manufactories Directorate was established; the Dadu Route prefectural command was established; revenue commissions for West Sichuan, Yan'an, Fengxiang, and Xingyuan were established.
s0055.idiomatic: On yiyou day the Treasury Bureau was abolished and merged into the Ministry of Revenue; the Dadu capital intendant's office concurrently managing the Palace Manufactories Directorate was established; the Dadu Route prefectural command was established; and revenue commissions for West Sichuan, Yan'an, Fengxiang, and Xingyuan were established.

s0056.literal: Following the memorials of Mirhuozhe, Misili, and others, ten thousand ingots of paper currency were assigned for markets at Bieshili, Hexi, and Shangdu.
s0056.idiomatic: Following the memorials of Mirhuozhe, Misili, and others, 10,000 ingots of paper currency were assigned for markets at Bieshili, Hexi, and Shangdu.

s0057.literal: Qohochi was retained as Yangzhou salt transport commissioner; eight hundred thousand shi of salt were purchased annually to atone for past offenses.
s0057.idiomatic: Qohochi was retained as Yangzhou salt transport commissioner; 800,000 shi of salt were purchased annually to atone for past offenses.

s0058.literal: On jihai day the Juma River at Zhuozhou burst its banks and scoured more than thirty li.
s0058.idiomatic: On jihai day the Juma River at Zhuozhou burst its banks and scoured more than 30 li.

s0059.literal: On gengzi day Huguang Branch Secretariat grand councillor Ala Haiya asked to go in person to the seacoast to gather Champa's scattered troops, again send them south on campaign, and also urge those who had not yet departed; this was granted.
s0059.idiomatic: On gengzi day Huguang branch secretariat grand councillor Ala Haiya asked to go in person to the seacoast to gather Champa's scattered troops, send them south again on campaign, and urge those who had not yet departed; this was granted.

s0060.literal: On renyin day the Jiang-Huai Branch Secretariat presented one hundred boys and girls from each wing.
s0060.idiomatic: On renyin day the Jiang-Huai branch secretariat presented 100 boys and girls from each wing.

s0061.literal: Hudutemur's army campaigning against Burma was routed by bandit attack.
s0061.idiomatic: Hudutemur's army campaigning against Burma was routed by bandit attack.

s0062.literal: On wushen day King Wang Chun of Goryeo and the princess came to court with their heir Yuan.
s0062.idiomatic: On wushen day King Wang Chun of Goryeo and the princess came to court with their heir Yuan.

s0063.literal: An edict ordered two thousand troops of the Tian and Yang families of Si and Bo dispatched to join the Burma campaign.
s0063.idiomatic: An edict ordered 2,000 troops of the Tian and Yang families of Si and Bo dispatched to join the Burma campaign.

s0064.literal: Jiangnan salt laborers and troops were registered; those who concealed themselves were punishable.
s0064.idiomatic: Jiangnan salt laborers and troops were registered; those who concealed themselves were punishable.

s0065.literal: The households under Huo'erhu and others reported famine; the Emperor said: "If famine victims are not relieved, what are stored grains for?
s0065.idiomatic: The households under Huo'erhu and others reported famine; the Emperor said, "If famine victims are not relieved, what are stored grains for?

s0066.literal: Ten thousand shi were issued for relief.

s0067.literal: The Kaiyuan and other routes pacification commission was ordered to build one hundred boats and assign them to the Gou Kingdom garrison troops.
s0067.idiomatic: The Kaiyuan and other routes pacification commission was ordered to build 100 boats and assign them to the Gou Kingdom garrison troops.

s0068.literal: The Yunnan Branch Secretariat, for capturing Jiangtou City in Burma, presented eighty boys and girls together with silver vessels, silks, and cloth.
s0068.idiomatic: The Yunnan branch secretariat, for capturing Jiangtou City in Burma, presented 80 boys and girls together with silver vessels, silks, and cloth.

s0069.literal: Fifth month, on jiyou day, following Tutugh's memorial, two thousand households were established to govern Qipchaq and Kangli youths who wished to serve the state.
s0069.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jiyou day, following Tutugh's memorial, 2,000 households were established to govern Qipchaq and Kangli youths who wished to serve the state.

s0070.literal: On renzi day the seal of the Eastern Expedition branch secretariat was confiscated.
s0070.idiomatic: On renzi day the seal of the Eastern Expedition branch secretariat was confiscated.

s0071.literal: On guichou day Privy Council officials said: "Suodu's routed troops have already been ordered collected by Li Heng; for routed troops of the Jiang-Huai and Jiangxi branch secretariats, separate envoys should be dispatched to summon and instruct them; all who arrive are to be given grain; damaged boats are to be repaired, to await Ala Haiya's deployment.
s0071.idiomatic: On guichou day privy council officials said, "Suodu's routed troops have already been ordered collected by Li Heng; for routed troops of the Jiang-Huai and Jiangxi branch secretariats, separate envoys should be dispatched to summon and instruct them; all who arrive are to be given grain; damaged boats are to be repaired, to await Ala Haiya's deployment.

s0073.literal: On wuwu day an edict to the Central Secretariat said: "Memorial headings and document registers must not use Uighur script; imperial commands and official letters must all use Mongol script.
s0073.idiomatic: On wuwu day an edict to the Central Secretariat said, "Memorial headings and document registers must not use Uighur script; imperial commands and official letters must all use Mongol script.

s0074.literal: On jiwei day the Jinghu-Champa Branch Secretariat said: "Huduhu, Umar, and others led troops against Champa; the vanguard naval force reached Shumei Lian Harbor and did not know where to go; wanhu Liu Junqing advanced the army and camped at Xin Prefecture; Champa tribesmen were captured, and only then did they learn that our army had already returned.
s0074.idiomatic: On jiwei day the Jinghu-Champa branch secretariat said, "Huduhu, Umar, and others led troops against Champa; the vanguard naval force reached Shumei Lian Harbor and did not know where to go; wanhu Liu Junqing advanced the army and camped at Xin Prefecture; Champa tribesmen were captured, and only then did they learn that our army had already returned.

s0075.literal: Champa tribesmen were immediately sent as guides to the Champa border; the king dispatched Abulan with a letter of surrender, saying also that his kingdom had been plundered by Suodu's armies and horses, state resources were exhausted, and he would wait until next year to send his eldest son with local products as tribute.
s0075.idiomatic: Champa tribesmen were immediately sent as guides to the Champa border; the king dispatched Abulan with a letter of surrender, saying also that his kingdom had been plundered by Suodu's armies and horses, state resources were exhausted, and he would wait until next year to send his eldest son with local products as tribute.

s0076.literal: His grandson Luosili Lezhe and others were subsequently dispatched bearing a memorial to court.
s0076.idiomatic: His grandson Luosili Lezhe and others were subsequently dispatched bearing a memorial to court.

s0077.literal: On yichou day iron produced by Goryeo was requisitioned.
s0077.idiomatic: On yichou day iron produced by Goryeo was requisitioned.

s0078.literal: Two tenths of this year's land tax in Jiangnan was remitted; all arrears before the eighteenth year that had not yet been collected were entirely exempted.
s0078.idiomatic: Two tenths of this year's land tax in Jiangnan was remitted; all arrears before the eighteenth year that had not yet been collected were entirely exempted.

s0079.literal: Aruhunu said: "Formerly three hundred thousand artisan households were selected from Jiangnan commoner households; many lacked craft skills; craftsmen of various trades have now been chosen; the remaining one hundred ninety-nine thousand and more households should be released to become commoners.
s0079.idiomatic: Aruhunu said, "Formerly 300,000 artisan households were selected from Jiangnan commoner households; many lacked craft skills; craftsmen of various trades have now been chosen; the remaining 199,000 and more households should be released to become commoners.

s0081.literal: An edict instructed the various surveillance and judicial commissions on matters of their sub-bureaus.
s0081.idiomatic: An edict instructed the various surveillance and judicial commissions on matters of their sub-bureaus.

s0082.literal: On gengwu day the Jinghu-Champa Branch Secretariat advanced troops and occupied Wuma territory, land near Annam; additional troops were requested; Ezhou darughachi Zhao Zhu and others were ordered to bear the imperial sealed letter to instruct Annam.
s0082.idiomatic: On gengwu day the Jinghu-Champa branch secretariat advanced troops and occupied Wuma territory, land near Annam; additional troops were requested; Ezhou darughachi Zhao Zhu and others were ordered to bear the imperial sealed letter to instruct Annam.

s0083.literal: Li Yizhu, a commoner of Renqiu County in Hejian, plotted rebellion; when the affair was discovered he was executed.
s0083.idiomatic: Li Yizhu, a commoner of Renqiu County in Hejian, plotted rebellion; when the affair was discovered he was executed.

s0084.literal: Private collections throughout the empire of astronomical charts, prognostications, the 《Great Unity Thunder Formula》, the 《Seven Luminaries Calendar》, the 《Back-Pushing Chart》, and the 《Inspector Miao Calendar》 were registered and seized; those who privately studied or concealed them were punished.
s0084.idiomatic: Private collections throughout the empire of astronomical charts, prognostications, the 《Great Unity Thunder Formula》, the 《Seven Luminaries Calendar》, the 《Back-Pushing Chart》, and the 《Inspector Miao Calendar》 were registered and seized; those who privately studied or concealed them were punished.

s0085.literal: On dingchou day Huduhu, Umar, Liu the wanhu, and others led twenty thousand Yangzhou branch secretariat troops to Suodu's army front; they encountered wind and ships scattered; the army was entirely routed.
s0085.idiomatic: On dingchou day Huduhu, Umar, Liu the wanhu, and others led 20,000 Yangzhou branch secretariat troops to Suodu's army front; they encountered wind and ships scattered, and the army was entirely routed.

s0086.literal: An edict ordered recovery of commission documents, tiger tallies, and imperial appointment letters granted to Umar and others and to their subordinate generals; Boluheda'er of Hexi and others were substituted in their place, subject to Ala Haiya's command.
s0086.idiomatic: An edict ordered recovery of commission documents, tiger tallies, and imperial appointment letters granted to Umar and others and to their subordinate generals; Boluheda'er of Hexi and others were substituted in their place, subject to Ala Haiya's command.

s0087.literal: Intercalary fifth month, on jimao day, Prince Falila was enfeoffed as commandery prince and granted a tiger tally.
s0087.idiomatic: In the intercalary fifth month, on jimao day, Prince Falila was enfeoffed as commandery prince and granted a tiger tally.

s0088.literal: Si and Bo prefectures were placed under the Shunyuan Route pacification commission; the Southwestern Barbarians pacification commission was abolished and a prefectural command established.
s0088.idiomatic: Si and Bo prefectures were placed under the Shunyuan Route pacification commission; the Southwestern Barbarians pacification commission was abolished and a prefectural command established.

s0089.literal: Paper currency was granted to the Mongol army of West Sichuan to equip armor and weapons; they were to farm vacant riverside land in Suining for food; holdings below four qing were exempt from land tax.
s0089.idiomatic: Paper currency was granted to the Mongol army of West Sichuan to equip armor and weapons; they were to farm vacant riverside land in Suining for food; holdings below four qing were exempt from land tax.

s0090.literal: Commander Wang Weizheng was ordered to register Sichuan commoner households.
s0090.idiomatic: Commander Wang Weizheng was ordered to register Sichuan commoner households.

s0091.literal: On xinsi day the spirit of the Xiaoqing River in Weihui Route was given the added title King of Overflowing Aid, Majestic Favor.
s0091.idiomatic: On xinsi day the spirit of the Xiaoqing River in Weihui Route was given the added title King of Overflowing Aid, Majestic Favor.

s0092.literal: On renwu day Mongol Palace Guard chief commander Bihuodai, returning from campaigning against Huang Hua, presented one hundred seventy-one persons.
s0092.idiomatic: On renwu day Mongol Palace Guard chief commander Bihuodai, returning from campaigning against Huang Hua, presented 171 persons.

s0093.literal: On yiyou day Hong City and Chahan Zhang within Yunnan territory were placed under the crown prince.
s0093.idiomatic: On yiyou day Hong City and Chahan Zhang within Yunnan territory were placed under the crown prince.

s0094.literal: On bingxu day the Traveling Censorate moved from Yangzhou to Hangzhou.
s0094.idiomatic: On bingxu day the traveling censorate moved from Yangzhou to Hangzhou.

s0095.literal: On gengyin day eighteen submitted cave Man officials were granted clothing and sent back.
s0095.idiomatic: On gengyin day 18 submitted cave Man officials were granted clothing and sent back.

s0096.literal: On guisi day the Prince of Beian was granted a gold seal with dragon knob.
s0096.idiomatic: On guisi day the Prince of Beian was granted a gold seal with dragon knob.

s0097.literal: The fur goods office was abolished.
s0097.idiomatic: The fur goods office was abolished.

s0098.literal: An audit was conducted of concealed fraud in building Japan expedition ships by the various Jiangnan branch secretariats; an edict directed that surveillance commissions must not obstruct it.
s0098.idiomatic: An audit was conducted of concealed fraud in building Japan expedition ships by the various Jiangnan branch secretariats; an edict directed that surveillance commissions must not obstruct it.

s0099.literal: On jiachen day Annam heir Chen Rixuan dispatched his palace secretary Chen Qianfu to offer jade cups, gold vases, pearl collars, gold gorgets, white apes, green doves, silks, and cloth as tribute.
s0099.idiomatic: On jiachen day Annam heir Chen Rixuan dispatched his palace secretary Chen Qianfu to offer jade cups, gold vases, pearl collars, gold gorgets, white apes, green doves, silks, and cloth as tribute.

s0100.literal: On bingwu day ten thousand palace guard troops were assigned to repair the Dadu city wall.
s0100.idiomatic: On bingwu day 10,000 palace guard troops were assigned to repair the Dadu city wall.
